title: Bound on total gate cost
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs, and let its size be $n$ plus its number of gates. If every gate of $C$ has at most $\mathrm{size}(C)$ arguments, then the sum over all gates of their number of arguments plus two is at most the number of gates times $\mathrm{size}(C)+2$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit on $n$ inputs
Each gate has at most $\mathrm{size}(C)$ arguments
